camel_example: aliyun emr UpdateClusterAutoRenew --region cn-hangzhou --AutoRenewInstances.1 'example-string' --ClusterAutoRenewDuration 1 --ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit Monthly --ClusterId 'c-d6661c71139a0000' --ClusterAutoRenew true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RenewAllInstances true --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of an EMR cluster and its ECS instances, specifically enabling or disabling auto-renewal
description_zh: 为您的EMR集群及其下ECS实例修改自动续费的属性，即配置自动续费的开启/关闭
kebab_example: aliyun emr update-cluster-auto-renew --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-d6661c71139a0000 --cluster-auto-renew true --cluster-auto-renew-duration 1 --cluster-auto-renew-duration-unit Monthly --renew-all-instances true --auto-renew-instances example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateClusterAutoRenew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the cluster. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
集群是否开启自动续费。取值范围：

true：开启自动续费。

false：不开启自动续费。

默认值：false
parameters.name: cluster_auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration of the cluster. This parameter takes effect only when ClusterAutoRenew is set to true.
If ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, and 36. If ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1, 2, and 3
parameters.help_zh:
集群自动续费时长。当 ClusterAutoRenew 取值为 true 时生效。
ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit取值为 Month 时，取值：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36。ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit取值为 Year时，取值：1、2、3
parameters.name: cluster_auto_renew_duration

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the auto-renewal duration of the cluster. Valid values:

Month: month.

Year: year.

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
集群续费时长单位。取值范围：

Month：月。

Year：年。

默认值：Month
parameters.name: cluster_auto_renew_duration_unit

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for all ECS instances in the cluster. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal for all ECS instances in the cluster. The default configurations apply auto-renewal for one month.

false: Does not enable auto-renewal for all ECS instances in the cluster. You can specify the ECS instances for which you want to enable auto-renewal in AutoRenewInstances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费。取值范围：

true：对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费，默认配置自动续费1个月。

false：不对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费。可在AutoRenewInstances中指定要配置自动续费的ECS实例。

默认值：false
parameters.name: renew_all_instances

fields.help_en: emr实例自动续费时长单位
fields.help_zh: emr实例自动续费时长单位
fields.name: emr_auto_renew_duration_unit

parameters.help_en: The list of ECS instances for which auto-renewal is configured. This parameter takes effect only when RenewAllInstances is not set to true
parameters.help_zh: 自动续费ECS实例列表。RenewAllInstances不为true时生效
parameters.name: auto_renew_instances
